title: Feedback reports record who sent them
description: The feedback sheet now says who is sending. A seated player sees 'Sending as <nickname>' and the report carries the nickname, seat position, the lobby nickname if it differs, and every seat's nickname and faction (so 'np gave me a note' can be mapped). Without a nickname (a spectator) an optional 'Your name' field appears. Mocked fixtures; the shots assert the payload. Regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CH.

shots.heading: Seated player, phone
shots.caption: 'Sending as Alex'. The nickname comes from the lobby roster; no name field is shown.

shots.heading: Seated player, desktop
shots.caption: Same on desktop. The privacy line now lists the name and the other players' nicknames.

shots.heading: No nickname: optional name, phone
shots.caption: A spectator has no nickname, so an optional 'Your name' field (44 px, 16 px text) appears; what is typed is stored as typed_name.

notes.title: Stored in the report
notes.text: context.sender: nickname, position, lobby_nickname (only when the nickname this browser remembers differs), typed_name. context.players (game info ticked): seat, position, nickname, bot, faction, is_sender for every seat. Never the seat token or any credential. Old reports lack these fields and still list fine.

notes.title: Lister
notes.text: tools/public/list_feedback.sh and server feedback-list print 'from Alex | table: Alex* (sol), np (letnev)' under each header line.
